question: Who released the National Strategy for Financial Inclusion (NSFI) 2025–30?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Malhotra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra released the National Strategy for Financial Inclusion (NSFI) 2025–30, approved by the Sub-Committee of the Financial Stability and Development Council.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The NSFI 2025–30 outlines five strategic objectives called “Panch-Jyoti”, supported by 47 action points.**
 
• **The strategy focuses on equitable, responsible, suitable, and affordable financial services to ensure household and micro-enterprise security.**
 
• **It adopts a gender-sensitive approach to strengthen women-led financial inclusion and supports vulnerable households.**
 
• **The framework emphasises financial education to promote financial discipline and informed decision-making.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Focus Areas of NSFI 2025–30**__

 __
 
• Strengthening grievance redressal and customer protection mechanisms.
 
• Synergising livelihood opportunities, skill development, and ecosystem linkages with financial inclusion programs.
 
• Enhancing financial resilience among underserved populations.
 
 
 
• **Development Process**__
 __
 
• Prepared by the Technical Group on Financial Inclusion and Financial Literacy.
 
• Formulated after extensive stakeholder consultations across India.
 
 
 
• **National Financial Inclusion Objectives**__
 __
 
• Improve access to affordable financial services.
 
• Promote trust, transparency, and responsible financial behaviour.
 
• Strengthen institutional coordination under FSDC sub-committee guidance.
 
 
 
• **Importance of the Strategy**__
 
 
• Aims to build a secure, inclusive, and transparent financial ecosystem.
 
• Supports long-term financial stability and economic empowerment of households.
